notes.title: ​Game Update 1.0.3: Enhanced Content Quality!
notes.content: [p]Update Highlights:[/p][p]Evidence System Improvements[/p][p]- Refined the structure of evidence collection to enhance logical consistency[/p][p]- Adjusted the sequence of information discovery to feel more natural[/p][p]- Improved connections between events and related evidence[/p][p]Character Enhancements[/p][p]- Refined character context and motivation to better align with story events[/p][p]- Deepened character development for more immersive storytelling[/p][p]- Polished dialogue to improve authenticity and natural flow[/p][p]This update significantly enriches the gameplay experience, bringing more coherence, emotional impact, and player engagement![/p]

notes.title: Game Update Coming Soon!
notes.content: [p]Our team is currently improving the evidence collection system and character contexts to make them more logical and realistic. This includes restructuring information discovery sequences and enhancing character development to better align with story events.[/p][p]This update will provide a smoother and more engaging gameplay experience. Stay tuned for more updates![/p][p][/p]
